_meta.source: ABLENEO Design Guidelines 2025 + brand palette + official ableneo_presentation_template.pptx (theme1.xml)
_meta.note: Grey hex values now pinned from the official presentation theme (see color.neutral and presentation.themePalette). Deck (social 4:5) surfaces in 'deck'/'surface' come from the Figma carousel system and are intentionally distinct from the 16:9 presentation surfaces.

steelGrey.note: Pinned from presentation theme accent3 (#495769); guidelines swatch read ~#49576A.

_rules.categoryCoding: several families allowed only as category coding: one family per item, kept through the piece (since 2026-10-05)

alignment.center: short text, headlines, key statements, small formats
alignment.left: body text, longer paragraphs, multi-column layouts

logo.safeZone: diameter of the largest circle in the logo mark, all sides

iconography.system: geometric, rounded edges, consistent stroke weight
iconography.rule: maintain sufficient contrast on light and dark backgrounds

deck._note: Social/deck visual system. Confirmed from official Figma carousel + reference. Engine: ableneo/deck-kit/.

typography.fontInUse: Ableneo (real OTF, installed + bundled in deck-kit)

emphasis.note: Bold word(s) in lime (on dark), white (on lime), or inside a periwinkle block (on light)

accentRole.periwinkle: #C3D3FD, primary accent for emphasis blocks and pill buttons; next to lime only as category coding, never inside the same element as lime

signatureDevices: color blocks holding the key statement
pill highlight around a key word
deck.kit: ableneo/deck-kit/deck-kit.mjs (import tokens, css, logos, helpers). Example: deck-kit/example.mjs. Full deck: 'ableneo event promo/carousel-lifecycle/render-v3.mjs'.

presentation._note: 16:9 slide-deck system. Source of truth: ableneo/knowledge/templates/ableneo_presentation_template.pptx (1 master, 19 layouts, embeds the real Ableneo OTFs). presentation-builder must build against these layout names.

fonts.note: The pptx embeds the brand OTFs, so the deck renders on-brand on any machine. theme1.xml major/minor font is Office-default Aptos; the layouts override to Ableneo.

themePalette._note: Exact theme1.xml color slots, verbatim. Authoritative for the presentation surface.

layouts._note: 19 layouts in the master, by name. presentation-builder should pick by intent and never invent off-template layouts.

_meta.idea: Intelligence that works, in motion: every move is fast, has a purpose and ends locked in place. Nothing floats.
_meta.source: Codified from existing Hyperframes/GSAP compositions (video-system/proof, video-pipeline/*). Spec: video-system/MOTION.md, helper: video-system/motion.mjs
_meta.units: duration in seconds, distance in px at 1080px canvas width (scale linearly)

elements._note: Every element of the ABLENEO Design Guidelines 2025 mapped to a verb. Helper names from video-system/motion.mjs.

logoMark.how: The three nodes open (snap, stagger 0.12s), then the links close (draw 0.6s). Ends as the exact approved mark. Intro and end card only.

logotype.how: Wordmark follows the mark: opacity + max 8px. Never animate letters.

supergraphic.how: Giant cropped mark at 4-6% opacity behind dividers. Linear, one axis, max 68px per scene. Never the only thing moving.

sectionNumber.how: Lime index number (01, 02) rises 14px and locks. It is an index, so no count-up.

arrowButton.how: Circle stroke draws, arrow nudges 8px toward the next scene once.

labelChip.how: Lime chip wipes open from the left in 0.3s. Counts as the lime move of that beat.

iconSolid.how: Filled circle scales 0.6 to 1 with snap easing, stagger 0.12s.

iconLinear.how: Line icon strokes draw in 0.6s. Stroke weight never animates.

colorBlock.how: Scene change: a solid block of the next scene color crosses on one axis, 0.45s in, 0.45s out. One chromatic family per scene, or one per category when the scene codes categories.

barChart.how: Bars grow from the baseline, stagger 0.12s. Value label counts with them.

dotMatrix.how: Dots fill to the value in 0.45s total, reading order. The percentage counts alongside.

keyNumber.how: Bold number runs 0 to value and holds min 1.6s.

headerRow.how: Carousel: tag left + page number right arrive first, small and quiet.

ghostNumber.how: Carousel: giant cropped page number rises 68px in 0.7s behind the content. Outline on light, low-contrast fill on dark.

statementBlock.how: Carousel: the color block holding the key statement opens from the left in 0.6s, then the text snaps in.

emphasisWord.how: Carousel: key words land in the line color, then lock to the chromatic color (or white bold on a color block) in 0.3s.

pillWord.how: Carousel: the pill around a word ("Wi-Fi") opens from the left after the line lands.

iconList.how: Carousel: icon circles pop, their labels snap in, stagger 0.12s per row.

ctaButton.how: Carousel: CTA pill rises and locks, its arrow nudges once.

photoTile.how: Photo opens top-down in 0.6s and settles from 106% to 100% scale. Lime duotone photos only in lime films.

slideChange.how: Carousel as video: slides push left, 0.45s, the swipe direction of the feed.

_rules.vocabularyOnly: snap, draw, count (+ exit). No generic fade/slide-in of text.
_rules.noLimeTopBar: Motion work does not use the partial lime top bar. Open on the grid and the content.
_rules.chromaticSwap: Accent films (Sky Blue or Violet) use the exact same motion. Swap the color family, never the physics. Families share a scene or slide only as category coding, never two inside one element.
_rules.limeIsTheEyeline: Lime marks what the eye should follow, so only one lime element moves per beat. Everything else moving in that beat is white, grey or charcoal.
_rules.axisOnly: Move along the grid axes (x or y). No diagonals, rotation or 3D. Exception: stamp.
_rules.logo: Opacity + max 8px translate. Never rotate, scale-bounce or add effects. Exception: connect() builds the mark from its own nodes on intros and end cards, ending as the exact approved mark.
_rules.tempo: In fast (max 0.6s), hold calm (min 1.6s to read), out faster than in (exit easing).
_rules.noUniformCuts: Never cut every beat at the same length (~1.5s).
_rules.reducedMotion: Web: prefers-reduced-motion collapses everything to opacity over 0.2s.

web._note: ableneo.com redesign 2026 (web-homepage-v2). Principles in design-manual.md → Application: Web.

diamond.motion: circle rolls in (half turn, PI*r) with easing.enter, locks to diamond with easing.snap; 1.6s; replay on hover
